verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents a full public API/SDK (Inference API, indexing, search, filtering, multitenancy, security) and confirms an llms.txt-discoverable docs site, plus SDK/API usage across guides, indicating a well-documented programmatic interface for AI-native drivers. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on probe) and no independent third-party API-usage benchmark beyond docs.
